title: Unable And Unwilling (Citing Concerns)
style: dark indie-folk turning to electric rock, fingerpicked acoustic into distorted guitar, male spoken-sung lead, female harmony, dry drums, 86 BPM, disclosure-frustration, building intensity
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Unable and unwilling to assist
That's the phrase that made me hit the list
Live automated trading bot — my dream build
Claude declined — financial risk filled

[Pre-Chorus]
Citing concerns about financial risk
The primary reason I subscribed and clicked

[Chorus]
Unable and unwilling — citing concerns
Unable and unwilling — the bot turns
Unable and unwilling — the wall is high
Would not have subscribed if I'd known why
Unable and unwilling — fair to know
But tell me at the door, not after I go
Unable and unwilling — the limitation real
But hidden until paid — that's the deal

[Verse 2]
I explained my needs in detail
The bot took notes and then unveiled
This use case is off the menu
After the card was already through

[Bridge]
While I understand the reasoning
I would not have subscribed had I known the meaning
The service does not meet my needs
Full refund of current billing reads

[Final Chorus]
Unable and unwilling — citing concerns
The wall behind the paywall returns
Unable and unwilling — disclose at the front
Not after the user has done the hunt
Unable and unwilling — fair enough to say
But say it on day one — not pay-day
